annotation.speech2: An ellipse centered at the origin, wider than it is tall, crossing the positive x-axis at a and the positive y-axis at b. The region E inside it is shaded gray, and two arrowheads on its boundary C show that C is traversed counterclockwise.
The ellipse x squared over a squared plus y squared over b squared equals 1, enclosing the shaded region E.
An arrowhead near the top of the ellipse, pointing to the left: C is traversed counterclockwise.
